description: A power strip lies on the bed in front of a pillow, with a white charging block plugged in and its cable draped across the sheet. The left hand slides in from the lower left and steadies the power strip near the sockets, while the right hand moves in from the right and grips a plug at the end of the strip, nudging and wiggling it at the socket as if to insert or remove it; the right-hand object is the plug and the left hand is just bracing the strip.
